variants.headline: Colony openly defies its charter
variants.body: The colony is openly defying its charter. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Charter compliance becomes an open dispute
variants.body: The colony has taken an openly defiant position towards its charter. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
